explicit_validation.explanation: Paper explicitly validates LLM evaluation (Eve-Cov metric) against human evaluation by comparing agreement scores between human annotators, GPT4o evaluation, and the proposed metric

prompts.notes: Exact prompts provided in appendix for MCMS, TQA-generation, and TQA tasks

guidelines.notes: Manual evaluation assigns scores 0-5 for each aspect of event coverage and faithfulness; detailed case study with aspects shown

sample_size.notes: Paper compares agreements but exact validation sample size not specified

quantitative_scores.notes: Eve-Cov metric achieves higher agreement than GPT4o evaluation

validation_results.summary_finding: The proposed Eve-Cov metric demonstrates higher agreement with human evaluation (84.73) compared to GPT4o evaluation (82.27), showing improved reliability for event coverage assessment.

criteria_mapping.notes: LLM evaluation assesses redundancy, omission, and conflict during silver-standard summary generation, while both LLM (Eve-Cov metric) and human evaluation assess event coverage and faithfulness
